svg.text: AU Bank Insurance Distribution Platform — How This Pack Actually Gets Approved
the AIGEM seven-board model with one aggregator and one gate · replaces the five-step CTO flow in v0.1, which described an authority the matrix does not define
Correction carried from the v0.1 review (finding F-56)

v0.1 drew a five-step flow placing a 'Chief Technology Officer' review ahead of the mandatory approvers. PERSONA-AUTHORITY-MATRIX v1.6 defines no CTO persona; strategic technology sits with Architecture (A/AP) and funding with an Executive Sponsor who does not exist (GAP-010). The real model is below.
SEVEN BOARDS · EACH ANSWERS ONLY ITS OWN CHECKLIST · SILENCE IS NEVER ASSENT
scope, journey behaviour, acceptance, KPI semantics
one gate · records to approval-gate.schema.json · max two rounds, then ESCALATED
round 2 only — a third round is not permitted
may not be re-litigated without new evidence
unresolved after two rounds, or a standing veto
THE RULES THAT DECIDE WHETHER THIS PACK CAN BE APPROVED AT ALL
It changes, or asserts, the behaviour of authorization (G1),
and reconciliation (G5), consent capture and retention (G6)
and production topology (G8). Any one fires T4.
Security (Board 4) and Risk & Compliance (Board 6) at T4
require reviewer_type: HUMAN. No aggregate override exists,
and no AI simulation — including this pack's own review
An agent verdict with empty evidence is invalid
Rule RG-3: it is treated as NOT_RUN, not as approval. Every
board verdict must cite a path a reader can open.
An agent that authored the plan may produce verdicts for it,
marked self_review: true — and a self-reviewed T3+ plan
still needs at least one human board.
At the next stage boundary (11 §14). An approval carried
across a gate is not an approval, it is an assumption.
CMP-6. Unlike technical debt, there is no 'accept with
expiry' path for a compliance control.
SIGNATURE LEDGER — ONE TABLE, USED IDENTICALLY IN ALL EIGHT DOCUMENTS
Rajal — Principal Insurance Platform Product Owner
cannot be satisfied without the S07-G3 threat model
S07-G5: data architecture incl. backup and retention
SEAT NOT FILLED — owns reconciliation in this pack
settlement timing, break ownership, refund accounting
FRI-001 funding line has no approver
DRAFT FOR REVIEW · v0.2 · not approved, not authorised for development · AI-drafted; no human signature
WS-3 · AU Bank Insurance Distribution Platform · R0
